equivalence_proof.projection: service, mode, bytes; leases ref -> (pid, bytes, cleanup, request_active); cleanups token -> (lease, bytes, receipt)
equivalence_proof.comparison: strict ===; only adjacent equal projections suppressed
equivalence_proof.fixed_scope: One Gate PID per observer; gate snapshot identity is unchanged.
equivalence_proof.equivalence: Equal raw references/scalars/maps imply identical inspected identities, sorted snapshot rows, row counts, byte sums and total-invariant outcome. Thus original serialized snapshot and digest are identical. An adjacent duplicate was already rejected by the unchanged observer seen-set.
excluded: other fields not read by admission_snapshot
equivalence_proof.capture: Changed projection sends original complete app_state; original snapshot/hash/global dedup/distinct cap/invariants run unchanged in observer.
equivalence_proof.cost: Projection/equality and BEAM send-copy scale with bounded lease/cleanup counts; no Gate inspect, sorting, hashing or serialization.
